intro.headline: I'm Solale Hamzeh UI/UX Designer & Junior Product Designer.

physicalSection.title: My Physical Products
physicalSection.description:
Project Concept:
This product was born out of a personal need for privacy and focus within shared working environments. While working on design projects, I often found myself distracted by surrounding activity and a lack of visual boundaries. Existing solutions on the market were either too industrial, visually unappealing, or lacked adaptability. This gap inspired me to design a practical, minimal, and portable partition that would address these limitations.

Design Objective:
To create a lightweight and compact desk partition that enhances visual privacy while supporting customization and organization within personal workspaces.

Features & Functionality:
- Reduces side-view distractions and enhances visual focus
- Can be used as a pinboard for notes, reminders, or creative elements
- Optimized dimensions to suit various desk types
- Lightweight structure with durable material selection
- A clean, minimalist aesthetic that complements modern work environments

Development Process:
The design process began with a detailed needs assessment and evolved through material exploration, hand prototyping, and iterative refinement based on real-world testing. Special attention was given to ergonomics, form, and usability. From concept to production, the entire process was executed independently.

Outcome:
WallSpace is my first handcrafted product and was developed entirely by myself from start to finish. To date, over 15 units have been produced and tested successfully in real workspace scenarios.

aboutSection.subtitle: About Me
aboutSection.title: Turning complex problems into simple design
aboutSection.text: As a UI/UX Designer I specialize in crafting user-centered digital products for both B2B and B2C audiences. Since February 2024, I've been actively working on real-world projects, collaborating with developers to transform ideas into clean, intuitive, and effective digital experiences that align with business goals.

experiences.title: UI/UX Designer
experiences.description: Worked within a cross-functional team designing user interfaces and improving overall user experience across multiple projects. Collaborated closely with developers to translate design concepts into functional, polished products, ensuring smooth communication throughout the implementation process.
